svg.title: A kagent turn costs the same with a pause and with no pause
svg.desc: Every run of our kagent test with a mock model, as one dot each, with the median as a line. Resume 0.380 s over 98 turns, suspend 0.142 s over 99 suspends, a turn 4 seconds after the last one 0.726 s, a turn with no pause 0.738 s, and the first turn of a new Session 0.605 s.
svg.text: seconds for each run, with a mock model
THE WHOLE TURN, IN THE CLUSTER
one dot: one run, sorted from the fastest to the slowest. black line: the median.
